properties.name: BFR42
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: The site comprises two residential dwellings, their gardens and an area of scrubland. Bounded by London Road to the west, Donnington Manor to the north, open countryside to the east and residential development to the south. Mature trees line the north and south boundaries of the site.
